sentences.text: This fruit you eat all the time... is actually radioactive!
Bananas are rich in potassium, a key mineral for your muscles and heart.
A tiny part of that potassium is potassium-forty, which naturally gives off radiation.
It's so famous that scientists have an unofficial term, the "banana equivalent dose", to explain radiation in a way anyone can understand.
A flight of a few hours exposes you to radiation equal to hundreds of bananas.
And a CT scan... tens of thousands of bananas!
You'd only get a dangerous dose by eating tens of millions of bananas at once, which is clearly impossible.
Your body also gets rid of extra potassium right away.
Bonus fact: your own body is a little radioactive too, because of that same potassium!
